datasets.name: QTP dataset (Qinghai-Tibet Plateau landslides dataset)
datasets.verbatim: The QTP dataset [29] is available at http://ieee-dataport.org/documents/qinghai-tibet-plateau-qtp-landslides-dataset.

datasets.name: Optical remote sensing images from Google Earth Pro
datasets.source: Google Earth Pro (CNES Airbus and Maxar Technologies)
datasets.verbatim: A total of 516 optical remote sensing images with various pixel resolutions within the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau (QTP) region of China were acquired using Google Earth Pro [27]... Google. (2024). Google Earth. Accessed: Jan. 9, 2024. [Online]. Available: https://earth.google.com

methods.name: Mask R-CNN with integrated post-processing branch
methods.summary: A Mask R-CNN instance segmentation model with a 50-layer residual net and feature pyramid network backbone, augmented with a custom post-processing branch to filter overlapping landslide mask predictions based on IoU and prediction scores.
methods.verbatim: The implementation code is available at https://github.com/zwang-iggcas/landslide-area-delimitation.

availability.author_statement: Data availability statement present with shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is linked via IEEE DataPort, and other input datasets are accessible through Google Earth. The custom Mask R-CNN implementation code is provided via a GitHub repository link.
